conceptual_change: Transitioning from price-based momentum metrics to volume-intensity attenuation. Instead of price-level breakouts, this hypothesis identifies trend exhaustion through the persistent decay of trade volume relative to the rolling 48-hour average, signaling a lack of institutional conviction in the prevailing trend direction.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
